data.gender_notes: Milana is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic root word ‘milo,’ meaning ‘gracious,’ and ‘ana,’ meaning ‘dear.’ The name Milana signifies one who is gracious and dear. The name Milana carries the meaning “Gracious, Dear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Milana usually hope their child will grow to embody gracious, dear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing compassion and grace.
data.etymology: Milana belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gracious, Dear.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Milana total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_greek.name: Μιλάνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μιλάνα προέρχεται από το αρχαίο ελληνικό όνομα «Μίλης» που σημαίνει «δυναστεία», «δύναμη» και «ανεξαρτησία». Το όνομα επηρεάστηκε από το λατινικό όνομα «MILAN» που σημαίνει «δυναστεία». Στη γη των Ελλήνων και της Ελληνικής γλώσσας, το όνομα Μιλάνα έχει σημασία που σχετίζεται με την «δύναμη», την «ανεξαρτησία» και την «δυναστεία».

in_latin.name: Milana
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Milana derivatur a nomine Latino «MILAN» quod significat «fortitudo», «virtus et libertas». In scriptis antiquis Latinis, «MIL» significabat «fortitudo», «virtus» et «libertas». Nomen Milana fuit et «nomen» Dei in scriptis antiquis Latinis.
